title: Public Software catalog
description: catalog.toml: every repository of the organization with its ring, layers, wave, purpose and planned contents. Repository names are unique (checked by the validators; not expressible here).

org.description: the GitHub organization every repository belongs to

site.description: the organization's site; a repository's homepage is <site>/<name>

name.description: GitHub repository name; .github is the organization's community-health repository

ring.description: dependency ring; only the platform ring may be depended on across rings

wave.description: the wave in which work on the repository starts

layers.description: stack layers the repository serves; all for the spine

purpose.description: one sentence: what the repository is for

contents.description: planned crates, apps, services or documents, separated by ·
